notes: P3, the newsroom agent of the sgit.ai sites: read the system and a vault checkout at /work/vault, write its output under /work/out only, run the system, TCP connect to port 443 (the vault host and the model API; which hosts is sharness.net's job), 1 GiB, 64 processes.
